Prominent_Tympanal_Membrane.description: A large, exposed, disc-like eardrum situated flush against the side of the head. It acts as both an acoustic receiver for high-frequency mating calls and a resonating chamber for sensing very low-frequency seismic rumblings.

Subterranean_Vestigial_Ears.description: Completely internal auditory canals buried beneath thick skin and bone, trading airborne sound perception entirely for the conduction of low-frequency vibrations straight through the jawbone while burrowing.
